title: Wati Alternatives for Selling on WhatsApp
summary: Compare 6 Wati alternatives for WhatsApp sales: AI that answers from your catalog, handoff, channels and prices checked on vendor pages in November 2026.
body_markdown:
Wati is a solid WhatsApp inbox with broadcasts, templates and a catalog. Lots of small shops and service businesses start there, and it does the job while most of the work is sending campaigns.


Selling in the chat is a different job. Customers ask what something costs, whether it comes in their size and how to pay, and they expect an answer in seconds, at night and on weekends too. That's usually when teams notice how the price climbs with AI credits, extra users and add-ons, and start shopping around.


We compared six Wati alternatives for WhatsApp sales and checked every price on the vendors' own pricing pages in November 2026:


- **Chatfuel** : an AI Agent that answers from your catalog on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok and website chat, with handoff to your team and one inbox.
- **respond.io** : an omnichannel inbox for teams that work leads across many channels.
- **SleekFlow** : omnichannel messaging with strong tools for Shopify stores.
- **AiSensy** : WhatsApp campaigns with a free plan and store integrations.
- **Zoko** : WhatsApp for Shopify brands, with ordering and payment in the chat.
- **Kommo** : a sales CRM that turns WhatsApp and Instagram chats into deals.


## What to look for in a Wati alternative for sales


Most WhatsApp tools can send a broadcast. For selling, these four things decide whether the chat closes the sale:


- **Answers from your catalog.** The assistant should know your products, prices and options, and reply in the customer's words instead of a menu of buttons.
- **A clean handoff.** A big order, a complaint or a custom request should reach a person, with the whole conversation in front of them.
- **How the price grows.** Look at what happens when you add teammates, a second channel or more AI replies. Seat fees, AI credit packs and add-ons change the real cost.
- **Where your customers write.** If half of them message you on Instagram, a WhatsApp-only tool means a second inbox.

## 1. Chatfuel


Chatfuel is built for selling and booking in the chat. Its AI Agent reads your catalog and business facts and answers customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok and website chat, all in one **Chats** inbox.


**Strengths for WhatsApp sales:**


- **Answers from your catalog.** Each item has a name, a description with options, prices and availability, and up to 10 photos. The AI Agent answers in the customer's language, voice messages included, and sends the photos.[How to set up the AI Knowledge Base](https://chatfuel.com/docs/ai-features/how-to-set-up-knowledge-base) .
- **Payment links.** Paste your Stripe, PayPal or Square link into the AI instructions and the AI Agent shares it when the customer is ready to pay.[How to make the AI send a payment link](https://chatfuel.com/docs/ai-features/how-to-make-ai-send-payment-link) .
- **Handoff and leads.** Up to 20 rules in **Switch to human agents** route chats to the right teammate, and the AI stops as soon as someone replies. Lead details go to the contact card and the **Kanban board** .
- **Follow-ups, broadcasts and ads.** Follow-ups inside the 24-hour window, scheduled messages from **Broadcasts** , a separate automation for Click-to-WhatsApp ads and conversion events sent to Meta.


**Price:** $20 a month with $20 in credits for AI replies and Meta's WhatsApp fees, or $18 a month billed yearly. No seat fees, per-channel fees or feature add-ons. The 7-day trial asks for a card to start.[See Chatfuel pricing](https://chatfuel.com/pricing) .


**Best for:** small and midsize businesses that sell and book in chats on more than one channel.


**Keep in mind:** the catalog is added item by item (or pasted as a price list to the AI assistant in the dashboard) and does not sync with Shopify or Meta Commerce Manager. AI replies are text and catalog photos, without buttons.


***See also:***[WhatsApp Catalog Bot: Prices, Stock and Checkout Links](https://chatfuel.com/blog/whatsapp-catalog-checkout-setup-guide)


## 2. respond.io


respond.io is an omnichannel inbox for teams that handle a high volume of conversations across chat channels, email and calls, with workflows to route and follow up on every lead.


**Strengths for WhatsApp sales:**


- **AI from the first plan.** Starter includes AI Prompt and AI Assist for writing and improving replies; AI agents that answer on their own come with Growth.
- **Meta product catalog.** Products from your Meta catalog can be shared in WhatsApp conversations.
- **Ads.** Built-in support for Meta and TikTok ads that start conversations.
- **Trial without a card.** The 7-day trial gives Growth features for 5 users, with no credit card needed.


**Price:** $99 a month, or $79 billed yearly. AI credits are included, with extra credits at $15 per 1,000.[See respond.io pricing](https://respond.io/pricing) .


**Best for:** sales and support teams that work leads across many channels.


**Keep in mind:** WhatsApp fees are not included in any plan, and AI agents start on the second plan.


## 3. SleekFlow


SleekFlow brings messaging, email and calls into one inbox, with every channel included on every plan and a strong set of tools for online stores.


**Strengths for WhatsApp sales:**


- **Commerce tools.** WhatsApp catalog, Stripe payment links and a Shopify connection; on Pro, the AI agent can build Shopify carts.
- **All channels on every plan.** Messaging, email and call channels are part of each plan.
- **AI agents on Pro.** Pro includes AI agents and 3,000 AI credits a month; Essential has an AI co-pilot for the inbox.
- **Easy start.** A 7-day Pro trial with a free WhatsApp Business API number and no credit card.


**Price:** $69 a month, or $49 billed yearly, for Essential with 3 seats. Essential is rolling out by country.[See SleekFlow pricing](https://sleekflow.io/en-us/pricing) .


**Best for:** Shopify stores that want an AI agent connected to their store.


**Keep in mind:** broadcast message fees are charged separately, and extra AI credits are sold in packs ($20 for 5,000).


## 4. AiSensy


AiSensy is a WhatsApp platform popular with small businesses for broadcasts and campaigns, with a free plan to start on the WhatsApp Business API.


**Strengths for WhatsApp sales:**


- **Free plan.** A free-forever plan, so you can start with no fixed cost.
- **Store integrations.** Shopify and WooCommerce integrations and WhatsApp catalogs.
- **Broadcasting.** Campaign tools for sending to large lists.
- **Add-ons when you need them.** An AI chat agent and chatbot flows can be added to any plan.


**Price:** free plan; paid plans from $45 a month, billed monthly. The AI chat agent is $50 a month with 1,000 AI messages, and chatbot flows are $80 a month.[See AiSensy pricing](https://aisensy.com/pricing/usd) .


**Best for:** WhatsApp campaigns on a small budget.


**Keep in mind:** it covers WhatsApp only, and AI replies cost extra on every plan.


## 5. Zoko


Zoko is built for Shopify brands that sell on WhatsApp, with ordering and payment inside the chat.


**Strengths for WhatsApp sales:**


- **Shopify-native flows.** Cash-on-delivery to prepaid flows and cart recovery for Shopify stores.
- **Orders in the chat.** Customers browse the WhatsApp catalog, order and pay without leaving the conversation.
- **AI sales agent.** An AI agent add-on, with a version priced on a share of order value.
- **Flexible billing.** Pay monthly or yearly, with a 7-day trial.


**Price:** $49.99 a month plus $0.015 per conversation. The AI agent is $24.99 a month plus $0.09 per resolution, or plus 3% of order value for the sales agent. Instagram is $9.99 a month.[See Zoko pricing](https://www.zoko.io/pricing) .


**Best for:** Shopify stores that sell mostly on WhatsApp.


**Keep in mind:** you pay WhatsApp fees directly to Meta, and AI costs grow with every resolved chat or order.


## 6. Kommo


Kommo is a sales CRM built around pipelines, where WhatsApp and Instagram chats turn into deals your team moves to the close.


**Strengths for WhatsApp sales:**


- **Pipelines.** Every chat becomes a lead in a visual sales pipeline.
- **Channels included.** Each plan includes one WhatsApp number and an Instagram account, with more channels through integrations.
- **Ads data.** Meta Conversions API and lead ads support.
- **AI on every plan.** Base includes AI basics and 750 AI credits per user; up to 3 AI agents come with Advanced.


**Price:** $25 per user a month on Base, paid for at least 6 months. Advanced is $35 per user. There's a 14-day trial.[See Kommo pricing](https://www.kommo.com/buy/tariff/) .


**Best for:** sales teams that work every chat as a deal in a pipeline.


**Keep in mind:** the price grows with every user, and monthly billing isn't available.


## How to move from Wati to Chatfuel


1. **Build first.** Set up the AI Agent, your catalog and your rules in Chatfuel before you connect a number. Everything is saved as a draft and goes live when WhatsApp connects.


The Catalog is what the AI Agent sells from: names, descriptions, prices and photos.


1. **Release your number.** A WhatsApp number can sit with one provider at a time, so release it from your current provider and[check that it's released](https://chatfuel.com/docs/whatsapp/how-to-check-if-whatsapp-number-is-released) in Meta Business Settings.
2. **Connect WhatsApp in Chatfuel** and turn the AI on for direct messages, Click-to-WhatsApp ads and posts that click to WhatsApp.[How to activate AI in WhatsApp](https://chatfuel.com/docs/whatsapp/how-to-activate-ai-in-whatsapp) .
3. **Recreate your templates** in Meta's WhatsApp Manager if they don't carry over with the number. Meta usually approves them within 24 hours.


Once WhatsApp is connected, the AI Agent replies with prices and options from your catalog.


If you still answer some chats from the WhatsApp Business app on your phone, Chatfuel can[connect that number alongside the app](https://chatfuel.com/docs/whatsapp/connect-whatsapp-business-app-number) and import up to six months of chat history.


## Summary


- For selling in the chat, look for AI that answers from your catalog and a clean handoff to a person. **Chatfuel** has both on every plan, on WhatsApp and four more channels, from $20 a month with no seat fees.
- **respond.io** and **SleekFlow** fit omnichannel teams; SleekFlow has the deeper Shopify tools.
- **AiSensy** is the budget pick for WhatsApp campaigns, **Zoko** is made for Shopify stores selling on WhatsApp, and **Kommo** for teams that run every chat as a deal.
- Whatever you choose, add Meta's WhatsApp fees to the plan price.


To see how an AI assistant handles a sales chat step by step, read[AI Assistant for WhatsApp Sales: How It Works](https://chatfuel.com/blog/ai-sales-assistant-whatsapp) . If you mostly send campaigns rather than sell in the chat, see[Best WhatsApp marketing software: 6 free and paid tools](https://chatfuel.com/blog/whatsapp-marketing-software) . For Instagram automation, compare[9 best ManyChat alternatives, free and paid](https://chatfuel.com/blog/manychat-alternatives) , or see how Chatfuel sells on WhatsApp on the[WhatsApp page](https://chatfuel.com/whatsapp) .


## FAQs


### What is a good alternative for selling on WhatsApp?


Chatfuel is built for it: the AI Agent answers product and price questions from your catalog, shares your payment link, and hands the chat to a teammate when a person is needed. It also works on Instagram, Messenger, TikTok and website chat, from $20 a month with no seat fees.


### Can an AI assistant answer product questions on WhatsApp?


Yes. In Chatfuel, the AI Agent reads your catalog (names, descriptions, prices, options and photos) and answers in the customer's own words and language, including voice messages. It sends catalog photos when asked and can share your payment link.


### Can I keep my WhatsApp number when I switch platforms?


Yes. Release the number from your current provider, check in Meta Business Settings that it's released, then connect it in Chatfuel. You can set up the AI Agent beforehand, so it goes live as soon as the number connects.


### Are WhatsApp message fees included in the plan price?


Not with any of the tools here: Meta charges for WhatsApp messages separately. In Chatfuel, those fees come out of the same balance as your AI replies, so you get one bill. Click-to-WhatsApp ads still open a free 72-hour window.
